name: 5-min hunter step 1: Leg 34 winner anatomy, 11 markets (learn gold 2011-19)
verdict: Rejected: winners' attributes do not select winners
summary: ~194,000 filled Leg 34 setups on M5, 11 markets, each simulated alone. Before costs about zero on every market (ladder -0.07 to +0.04R; silver/oil/indices costs are lab estimates). Gold 2011-19: 43% reach +1R, 13% +5R, 6% +10R, 1.5% +20R. Top 10% runners look like all trades (lifts 0.86-1.15); top 1% lean to quiet volatility, a quiet day, a strong 4h push, small structure. Best 2-condition rule (cost_R low & EMA slope mid, 133 conditions) failed its own halves (-0.04 / +0.04R), then -0.08R gold 2020-22, -0.06R 2023-25, -0.10R pooled other markets (9 of 10 negative), -0.02R Jan-Sep 2026.

Ladder exit: gold 2011-19 -0.20R (all setups -0.15), 2020-22 -0.13, 2023-25 -0.12, other 10 markets -0.35 (all -0.31), Jan-Sep 2026 -0.14R. The profile concentrates runners and losers alike.

name: Hunter step 3: Leg 34 pocket scan, 11 markets x 6 timeframes x 3 sessions x 2 exits
summary: 396 cells (M5, M10, M15, M30, M45, H1; Asia/London/New York; t3 and ladder), selection on 2011-22 only. 1 cell passed discovery (GBPUSD H1 London t3, t 2.13; ~9 expected by luck) and lost in 2020-22 (-0.37R); 0 confirmed; no cell positive in 2011-19, 2020-22 and 2023-25. Before costs only 33% of cells positive in 2011-19 (medians -0.01 to -0.05R by timeframe); persistence before costs 34% vs 32% = luck. Higher timeframes cut the cost share (median after costs -0.27R M5 -> -0.20R H1) but the raw edge does not improve. Sessions alike (-0.23R). Past hint (sop_4leg_v1 EUR/GBP M30 16-20 UTC) negative on all 9 other markets (-0.04 to -0.51R).
